metadata.title: fix(tests): fix 5 failing Playwright regression test selectors
metadata.author: crivetimihai

description:
## Summary
- Fix selectors in `test_admin_crud_regression.py` to match actual admin UI: use `#add-server-form`, `#server-name`, `[data-testid="server-item"]` for scoped edit/delete buttons
- Handle `window.confirm()` dialogs via `page.on("dialog")` instead of looking for HTML modal buttons
- Assert CSS class `active` instead of `aria-selected` for tab persistence checks
- Use `#team-selector-button` and `#team-selector-items` for team selector tests

## Test plan
- [ ] Run `pytest tests/playwright/regression/test_admin_crud_regression.py -v --browser chromium -k "test_create_virtual_server_flow or test_edit_virtual_server_flow or test_delete_virtual_server_flow or test_selected_tab_persists_after_refresh or test_team_context_persists_after_refresh"`
- [ ] Verify all 5 previously failing tests now pass

commits.message:
fix(tests): fix 5 failing Playwright regression test selectors

Update selectors and assertions in test_admin_crud_regression.py to
match actual admin UI implementation:
- Use #add-server-form and #server-name instead of generic selectors
- Use [data-testid="server-item"] for edit/delete button scoping
- Handle window.confirm() dialogs instead of HTML modal buttons
- Assert CSS class "active" instead of aria-selected for tabs
- Use #team-selector-button and #team-selector-items for team selector

Signed-off-by: Mihai Criveti <crivetimihai@gmail.com>
commits.author: Mihai Criveti
